item.title: Apple Glasses Could Have 2 Cameras & Launch In Early 2027
item.description: Apple's smart glasses will have two cameras, one for capture and the other for computer vision, and launch in early 2027, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports.

item.title: Deadly Delivery Adds Mystery Room In Latest Update
item.description: Co-op parcel delivery horror game Deadly Delivery adds a new 'Mystery Room', door microphone, and other new mechanics.

item.title: Apple Vision Pro & Samsung Galaxy XR Get PC VR Foveated Streaming
item.description: Apple Vision Pro is officially getting PC VR foveated streaming, and Samsung Galaxy XR now has the feature via Guy Godin's Virtual Desktop.

item.title: Could A Binocular Meta Ray-Ban Display Successor Launch This Year?
item.description: A Meta Ray-Ban Display successor is set for later this year, The Information reports — a device Bloomberg previously described as binocular.

item.title: Rhythm-based Brawler Rager Hits PlayStation VR2 Next Month
item.description: Rhythm-based arena brawler Rager is set to release on PlayStation VR2 next month.

item.title: VR Spelunking Game Cave Crave Is Getting Tham Luang Cave
item.description: The infamous cave in which a youth football team was trapped in 2018 is coming to VR spelunking game Cave Crave.

item.title: Popular Mobile Game Vortex 9 Comes To VR Next Week With Crossplay
item.description: The bizarre weaponry and battle-ready pets of popular mobile shooter Vortex 9 are coming to VR soon on Quest headsets, with crossplay.

item.title: The Exorcist VR Game Forced To Change Title After Losing License
item.description: Due to the license-holder not renewing it, The Exorcist: Legion VR has been forced to rename to Exorcism of the Legion (Last Rites).

item.title: Pico To Detail visionOS Competitor For New Headset Next Month
item.description: ByteDance's Pico will detail its competitor to visionOS, which will include a shared-space for 2D and spatial apps to run together, set to debut in its next headset.

item.title: Meta "Explicitly Separating" Horizon Worlds From Quest & Focusing On Third-Party Apps
item.description: Meta says it's "explicitly separating" Horizon Worlds from Quest, in a blog post assuring developers that it's committed to the VR ecosystem.
